result.reason: The addition provides a professional-and-workmanlike standard, a 90-day conformance warranty, and repair/replacement/re-performance/refund remedies, while preserving the existing Y2K warranty and disclaimer. However, it does not reach even the fallback because it omits warranties for compliance with laws and absence of malicious code. It also limits conformance coverage to the Interface and Support Services deliverables rather than clearly covering all related software and deliverables, and the trigger “following delivery” is unclear for ongoing services. The changes are otherwise limited and professionally understandable.
